items.t: Head gasket leaks
items.job: Replace both head gaskets and resurface heads
items.note: A timing belt and water pump are often done at the same time. Cost rises if the heads are warped or cracked.

items.t: Turbo oil supply pipe can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace turbo oil supply pipe and add bracket per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Oil control valve cover bolts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten oil control valve cover bolts per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace short block (piston rings)
items.note: A class action extended coverage for many cars. Ask a dealer for an oil use test and check your VIN.

items.t: Valve springs can break (recall)
items.job: Replace engine valve springs per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if a broken spring damaged the engine.

items.t: Engine computer can overheat ignition coils (recall)
items.job: ECM software update and replace ignition coil if needed
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. The front exhaust pipe is also replaced if damaged.

items.t: PCV valve can break apart inside the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace PCV valve per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. If broken pieces are lost in the engine, the engine is replaced.

items.t: Secondary air pump relay can stick on (recall)
items.job: Replace secondary air pump relay per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Fuel can leak at a hose joint on cold starts (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel line per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Engine may stall on winter-blend fuel (recall)
items.job: Engine computer software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank low-pressure fuel pump per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Automatic may not hold in Park (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission parking rod per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: CVT shudder, jerking or hesitation
items.job: Replace CVT valve body and refill fluid
items.note: Subaru extended CVT coverage on many cars. Check your VIN. A full CVT replacement costs far more.

items.t: CVT shift cable nut may loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten shift cable nut per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Driveshaft center support bolts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Install new driveshaft center support bolts per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Front driveshaft joint can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace front driveshaft (axle) per recall
items.note: Price is per side. Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Front lower control arms can rust through (recall)
items.job: Replace front lower control arms per recall
items.note: Covered by a recall for many cars in salt states. Check your VIN. Add a wheel alignment.

items.t: Front control arm weld can fail (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace left front lower control arm per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Do not drive until it is checked. Add a wheel alignment.

items.t: Brake lines can corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines per recall
items.note: Covered by a recall for many cars in salt states. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Brake master cylinder may not work right (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Brake light switch can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Brake switch fault can disable EyeSight braking (recall)
items.job: Reprogram EyeSight driver assist per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Brake switch may be out of adjustment (recall)
items.job: Inspect and adjust brake light switch per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Cruise control cable can stick the throttle open (recall)
items.job: Install cruise cable retaining clip per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Remote starter fob can start the engine by itself (recall)
items.job: Replace remote starter key fobs per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Headlights may be too dim (recall)
items.job: Replace front headlamp assemblies per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Price covers both sides. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rearview camera image may fail (recall)
items.job: Infotainment software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Dash wiring can short and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect and clamp dash wiring; repair harness if damaged
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger occupant control unit per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Pinched wire can disable passenger airbag (recall)
items.job: Repair and reroute passenger seat sensor wiring
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Driver seat bolt can fall out (recall)
items.job: Install new driver seat rail bolt per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Wagon rear gate may drop (recall)
items.job: Replace rear gate stay per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Subaru dealer.

items.t: Touchscreen freezes, reboots or goes blank
items.job: Update head unit software; replace head unit if needed
items.note: Most cars need only the software update. A replacement head unit is the high end.

items.t: Wheel bearings wear out and start to howl
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing or hub assembly
